findings.title: Shadow audit is observational, not a proof of message causation
findings.details: Checks gold-to-attack vote transition, adjacent insider's previousvote and prior flags. No message intervention, alternative source exclusion or counterfactualgeneration. Multiple insiders may produce multiple events for the same honest switch.
